examples.en: Factories pollute the river.
We must not pollute the air.
The factory polluted the river when it cleaned its tanks.
The lights from the stadium polluted the night sky, and we couldn't see the stars.

usage: The factory polluted the river when it cleaned its tanks.

en: The desecration of something holy or sacred; defilement, profanation.

examples.en: Air pollution is a big problem.
We should reduce pollution.

en: A small and rather deep collection of (usually) fresh water, as one supplied by a spring, or occurring in the course of a stream; a reservoir for water.

examples.en: We swam in the swimming pool.
There is a pool of water on the floor.
the pools of Solomon
There is a limited pool of candidates from which to choose the new manager.
a pool of blood

usage: the pools of Solomon

en: (with "the") Those who have little or no possessions or money, taken as a group.

examples.en: The poor family needs help.
examples.cn: 这个贫困家庭需要帮助。

examples.en: He is poor but happy.
The poor are always with us.
We were so poor that we couldn't afford shoes.
That was a poor performance.
Oh you poor little thing.

usage: The poor are always with us.

en: A person who is popular, especially at a school.

examples.en: This song is very popular.
He is a popular teacher.
examples.cn: 他是一位受欢迎的老师。

usage: be popular with 受……欢迎；反义词 unpopular。

en: The people living within a political or geographical boundary.

examples.en: The city has a large population.
What is the population of China?
The population of New Jersey will not stand for this!
India has the third-largest population of English-speakers in the world.
The town’s population is only 243.
A seasonal migration annually changes the populations in two or more biotopes drastically, many twice in opposite senses.

usage: The population of New Jersey will not stand for this!

en: A place or location.

examples.en: He is in a sitting position.
She got a position in the bank.
examples.cn: 她在银行谋到了一个职位。

examples.en: Chief of Staff is the second-highest position in the army.
My position on this issue is unchanged.
Stand in this position, with your arms at your side.
Stop running all over the field and play your position!

usage: Chief of Staff is the second-highest position in the army.

en: A thing capable of being affirmed; something real or actual.

examples.en: He has a very positive attitude.
She gave a clearly positive answer.
I’m absolutely positive you've spelt that wrong.
‘Better’ is an irregular comparative of the positive form ‘good’.
The idea of beauty is not positive, but depends on the different tastes of individuals.
The box was not empty – I felt some positive substance within it.

usage: I’m absolutely positive you've spelt that wrong.

en: A possible one.

examples.en: Is it possible to finish today?
Please come as early as possible.
Jones is a possible for the new opening in sales.
It's not just possible, it's probable.
It's possible for anyone to learn to pay the bagpipes.
Jones and Smith are both possible for the opening in sales.

usage: Jones is a possible for the new opening in sales.

en: A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.

examples.en: I will post the letter today.
He posted a note on the wall.
examples.cn: 他把一张便条贴在墙上。

examples.en: ram a post into the ground
Post no bills.
to post someone for cowardice
Since Jim was new to the game, he had to post $4 in order to receive a hand.

usage: ram a post into the ground

en: A rectangular piece of thick paper or thin cardboard intended to be written on and mailed without an envelope. In the case of a picture postcard one side carries a picture or photograph.

examples.en: I sent a postcard to my friend.
examples.cn: 我给朋友寄了一张明信片。

examples.en: The postcard shows a nice beach.
examples.cn: 这张明信片展现了一片美丽的海滩。

examples.en: to postcard one's friends
to postcard one's news

usage: to postcard one's friends

en: Someone (implied male) who delivers the post (mail) to, and/or collects the post from, residential or commercial addresses, or from public mailboxes.

examples.en: The postman delivers letters daily.
The postman rang the bell.

en: The tuber of a plant, Solanum tuberosum, eaten as a starchy vegetable, particularly in the Americas and Europe; this plant.

examples.en: I ate a baked potato.
She peeled the potato.

en: A unit of mass equal to 16 avoirdupois ounces (= 453.592 37 g). Today this value is the most common meaning of "pound" as a unit of weight.

examples.en: The book costs five pounds.
She lost two pounds last week.
the Rhode Island pound; the New Hampshire pound

usage: the Rhode Island pound; the New Hampshire pound

en: The quality or state of being poor; lack of money

examples.en: Many children live in poverty.
examples.cn: 许多儿童生活在贫困中。

examples.en: We should fight poverty.
examples.cn: 我们应该与贫困作斗争。

examples.en: poverty of soil

usage: poverty of soil

en: Having, or capable of exerting power, potency or influence.

examples.en: He has a powerful voice.
The storm was very powerful.
Not very many (of them) had been damaged.
He was the very best runner there.

usage: Not very many (of them) had been damaged.

en: A part of an exam or series of exams in which the candidate has to demonstrate their practical ability

examples.en: This is a practical idea.
We need practical skills.
Jack didn't get an engineering degree, but has practical knowledge of metalworking.
Jack's knowledge has the practical benefit of giving us useful prototype parts.
All in all, Jack's a very practical chap.

usage: Jack didn't get an engineering degree, but has practical knowledge of metalworking.

en: Repetition of an activity to improve a skill.

examples.en: Practice makes perfect.
She does piano practice daily.
He will need lots of practice with the lines before he performs them.
Being on a team is hard: you're always having to go to practice while everyone else is taking it easy.
She ran a thriving medical practice.
It is good practice to check each door and window before leaving.

usage: practice doing 练习做；美 practise 作动词，practice 作名词。

en: To repeat (an activity) as a way of improving one's skill in that activity.

examples.en: You should practise speaking English.
He practises the piano every day.
You should practise playing piano every day.
If you want to speak French well, you need to practise.
They gather to practise religion every Saturday.
She practised law for forty years before retiring.

usage: You should practise playing piano every day.

en: Commendation; favourable representation in words

examples.en: The teacher praised her work.
He won praise for his help.
examples.cn: 他因乐于助人受到称赞。

examples.en: Be sure to praise Bobby for his excellent work at school this week.

en: Someone (or something) who is loved; a darling.

examples.en: Time is precious.
She has a precious ring.
The crown had many precious gemstones.   This building work needs site access, and tell the city council that I don't care about a few lorry tyre ruts across their precious grass verge.
My precious daughter is to marry.
He spent hours painting the eyes of the portrait, which his fellow artists regarded as a bit precious.
There is precious little we can do.

usage: The crown had many precious gemstones.   This building work needs site access, and tell the city council that I don't care about a few lorry tyre ruts across their precious grass verge.

en: To be in the habit of choosing something rather than something else; to favor; to like better.

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
Which do you prefer, red or blue?
examples.cn: 你更喜欢哪个，红色还是蓝色？

usage: I prefer tea to coffee.

en: Preparation

examples.en: We must prepare for the exam.
examples.cn: 我们必须为考试做准备。

examples.en: She prepared dinner for us.
We prepared the spacecraft for takeoff.
We prepared a fish for dinner.
We prepared for a bumpy ride.
She prepared a meal from what was left in the cupboards.

usage: prepare for 为……准备；preparation 准备。

en: The current moment or period of time.

examples.en: He gave me a nice present.
All the students were present there.
The barbaric practice continues to the present day.
Is there a doctor present?  Several people were present when the event took place.
a present wit
in the present study,  the present article,  the present results.

usage: The barbaric practice continues to the present day.

en: An act in the past which may be used as an example to help decide the outcome of similar instances in the future.

examples.en: The president gave a speech.
He is the president of the club.
The vast majority of presidents have been male.

usage: The vast majority of presidents have been male.

en: A pressing; a force applied to a surface.

examples.en: Do not put pressure on him.
He works well under pressure.
examples.cn: 他在压力下也能好好工作。

examples.en: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.
the pressure of poverty; the pressure of taxes; the pressure of motives on the mind; the pressure of civilization.
She has felt pressure lately because her boss expects her to get the job done by the first.
the pressure of business

usage: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.

en: To claim, to allege, especially when falsely or as a form of deliberate deception.

examples.en: He pretended to be asleep.
Do not pretend you do not know.
As children we used to go on "spying" missions around the neighbour's house, but it was all pretend.

usage: As children we used to go on "spying" missions around the neighbour's house, but it was all pretend.

en: To stop (an outcome); to keep from (doing something).

examples.en: We must prevent fires.
Nothing can prevent me.
I brush my teeth regularly to prevent them from turning yellow.

usage: prevent...from doing 阻止……做；名词 prevention。

en: The cost required to gain possession of something.

examples.en: The price of the book is ten yuan.
What is the price of the ticket?
I paid a high price for my folly.
to price eggs

usage: I paid a high price for my folly.

en: The quality or state of being proud; an unreasonable overestimation of one's own superiority in terms of talents, looks, wealth, importance etc., which manifests itself in lofty airs, distance, reserve and often contempt of others.

examples.en: He takes pride in his work.
She felt a sense of pride.
He had pride of ownership in his department.
to be in the pride of one's life.
I pride myself on being a good judge of character.

usage: He had pride of ownership in his department.

en: A primary election; a preliminary election to select a political candidate of a political party.

examples.en: He goes to primary school.
This is our primary task.
most common primaries
Children attend primary school, and teenagers attend secondary school.
Preferred stock has primary claim on dividends, ahead of common stock.

usage: most common primaries

en: Books and other material created by printing presses, considered collectively or as a medium.

examples.en: Please print your name here.
examples.cn: 请在这里用印刷体写你的名字。

examples.en: I will print the photo.
TV and the internet haven't killed print.
Write in print using block letters.
The print is too small for me to read.
Using a crayon, the girl made a print of the leaf under the page.

usage: TV and the internet haven't killed print.

en: One who makes prints.

examples.en: The printer is out of paper.
He bought a new printer.

en: A soldier of the lowest rank in the army.

examples.en: This is a private matter.
They had a private talk.
If you want to learn ballet, consider taking privates.
Her address is private; you can't have it.
private property
He quit public life, living quietly as a private citizen.

usage: If you want to learn ballet, consider taking privates.

en: That which is taken from another; something captured; a thing seized by force, stratagem, or superior power.

examples.en: He won the first prize.
She got a prize for her drawing.

en: In all likelihood.

examples.en: He will probably come late.
It will probably rain.

en: A difficulty that has to be resolved or dealt with.

examples.en: We have a math problem.
Can you solve this problem?
She's leaving because she faced numerous problems to do with racism.
You got a problem with that?

usage: She's leaving because she faced numerous problems to do with racism.

en: To yield, make or manufacture; to generate.

examples.en: The farm produces milk.
This factory produces cars.
to produce a side of a triangle
to produce a man's life to threescore
highly produced sound

usage: to produce a side of a triangle

en: A commodity offered for sale.

examples.en: This product is very popular.
They sell a new product.
That store offers a variety of products.  We've got to sell a lot of product by the end of the month.
Wash excess product out of your hair.
The product of last month's quality standards committee is quite good, even though the process was flawed.
I got some product here – you buying?

usage: That store offers a variety of products.  We've got to sell a lot of product by the end of the month.

en: The act of producing, making or creating something.

examples.en: Car production stopped.
The production of the film was long.
examples.cn: 这部电影的制作历时很久。

examples.en: The widget making machine is being used for production now.
The widgets are coming out of production now.
They hope to increase spaghetti production next year.
We went to a production of Hamlet.

usage: The widget making machine is being used for production now.

en: The most senior rank for an academic at a university or similar institution, informally also known as "full professor." Abbreviated Prof.

examples.en: The professor teaches history.
He is a professor at the university.

en: Total income or cash flow minus expenditures. The money or other benefit a non-governmental organization or individual receives in exchange for products and services sold at an advertised price.

examples.en: The shop made a big profit.
examples.cn: 这家店赚了一大笔利润。

examples.en: He sold it for a profit.
Reading such an enlightening book on the subject was of much profit to his studies.

usage: Reading such an enlightening book on the subject was of much profit to his studies.

en: A set of structured activities.

examples.en: We watched a TV program.
examples.cn: 我们看了一个电视节目。

examples.en: This computer program is useful.
Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.
The program consisted of ads for restaurants and the credits of everyone connected with the play.
Tonight’s program was hosted by Johnny Carson.
The program runs on both Linux and Microsoft Windows.

usage: Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.

en: A set of structured activities.

examples.en: The school programme is fun.
What is on the programme?
Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.
The program consisted of ads for restaurants and the credits of everyone connected with the play.
Tonight’s program was hosted by Johnny Carson.
The program runs on both Linux and Microsoft Windows.

usage: Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.

en: Movement or advancement through a series of events, or points in time; development through time.

examples.en: He made good progress.
We can see your progress.
Testing for the new antidote is currently in progress.
Science has made extraordinary progress in the last fifty years.
The thick branches overhanging the path made progress difficult.

usage: Testing for the new antidote is currently in progress.

en: A planned endeavor, usually with a specific goal and accomplished in several steps or stages.

examples.en: We did a science project.
examples.cn: 我们做了一个科学项目。

examples.en: The project is almost done.

usage: Projects like Pruitt-Igoe were considered irreparably dangerous and demolished.

en: An oath or affirmation; a vow

examples.en: I promise to help you.
He kept his promise.
if I make a promise, I always stick to it;  he broke his promise
She shows great promise as an actress.

The clouds promise rain.

usage: if I make a promise, I always stick to it;  he broke his promise

en: To declare formally, officially or ceremoniously.

examples.en: How do you pronounce this word?
She pronounces English well.

The doctor pronounced them legally dead.
The judge had pronounced often before, but never in front of such a crowd.
Actors must be able to pronounce perfectly or deliberately disabled.

usage: I hereby pronounce you man and wife.

en: The formal or informal way in which a word is made to sound when spoken.

examples.en: His pronunciation is clear.
Practice your pronunciation daily.
What is the pronunciation of "hiccough"?

usage: What is the pronunciation of "hiccough"?

en: Something set apart for a special use.

examples.en: Wear proper clothes for the trip.
Use the proper tool for the job.
examples.cn: 用合适的工具做这项工作。

en: In a proper manner, appropriately, suitably; correctly, justifiably

examples.en: Please close the door properly.
He did the work properly.
I was properly tired after that party.

usage: I was properly tired after that party.

en: To keep safe; to defend; to guard; to prevent harm coming to.

examples.en: We must protect the environment.

examples.cn: 保暖的衣服使我们免受寒冷。

examples.en: Condoms are designed to protect against sexually-transmitted diseases.

usage: Condoms are designed to protect against sexually-transmitted diseases.

en: The process of keeping (something or someone) safe.

examples.en: Trees give us protection from the sun.

Raincoats give protection from rain.

usage: Raincoats give protection from rain.

en: Feeling honoured (by something); feeling happy or satisfied about an event or fact; gratified.

examples.cn: 我为我的学校感到骄傲。

examples.en: She felt proud of her son.
I am proud of Sivu’s schoolwork.
I was too proud to apologise.
It was a proud day when we finally won the championship.
After it had healed, the scar tissue stood proud of his flesh.

usage: be proud of 以……为傲；名词 pride。

examples.en: Can you prove it is true?
He proved he was right.
I will prove that my method is more effective than yours.
It proved to be a cold day.
Have an exit strategy should your calculations prove incorrect.
The exception proves the rule.

usage: I will prove that my method is more effective than yours.

en: A phrase expressing a basic truth which may be applied to common situations.

examples.en: He quoted a Chinese proverb.
examples.cn: 他引用了一句中国谚语。

examples.en: A proverb teaches us a lesson.

en: To make a living; earn money for necessities.

examples.en: The school provides free lunch.

I'll lend you the money, provided that you pay it back by Monday.
Don't bother bringing equipment, as we will provide it.

usage: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.

en: The people in general, regardless of membership of any particular group.

examples.en: The library is a public place.
Do not speak in public.
Members of the public may not proceed beyond this point.

usage: Members of the public may not proceed beyond this point.

en: To issue (something, such as printed work) for distribution and/or sale.

examples.en: They publish a daily newspaper.
She published her first book.
examples.cn: 她出版了她的第一本书。

examples.en: Most of the sketches Faulkner published in 1925 appeared in the Sunday magazine section of the New Orleans Times-Picayune.
No newspaper published the victim's name.
Grove Press published many avant-garde authors.
Major city papers still publish daily.

usage: Most of the sketches Faulkner published in 1925 appeared in the Sunday magazine section of the New Orleans Times-Picayune.

en: An act of pulling (applying force)

examples.en: Pull the door open.
He pulled the heavy box.
He gave the hair a sharp pull and it came out.
She took a pull on her cigarette.
a zipper pull
In weights the favourite had the pull.

usage: He gave the hair a sharp pull and it came out.

en: To cause to suffer for crime or misconduct, to administer disciplinary action.

examples.en: The teacher punished the boy.
Bad behavior will be punished.
If a prince violates the law, then he must be punished like an ordinary person.

usage: If a prince violates the law, then he must be punished like an ordinary person.

en: The act or process of punishing, imposing and/or applying a sanction.

examples.en: The punishment was fair.
He received a light punishment.
a vehicle that can take a lot of punishment

usage: a vehicle that can take a lot of punishment

en: A learner under the supervision of a teacher or professor.

examples.en: The pupil answered the question.
examples.cn: 这个小学生回答了问题。

examples.en: There are thirty pupils in the class.

en: An objective to be reached; a target; an aim; a goal.

examples.en: What is the purpose of this trip?
examples.cn: 这次旅行的目的是什么？

examples.en: He came for a clear purpose.
examples.cn: 他带着明确的目的而来。

examples.en: The purpose of turning off the lights overnight is to save energy.

usage: The purpose of turning off the lights overnight is to save energy.

en: A short, directed application of force; an act of pushing.

examples.en: Push the button to start.
Do not push the little boy.
Give the door a hard push if it sticks.
One more push and the baby will be out.
Let's give one last push on our advertising campaign.
server push; a push technology

usage: Give the door a hard push if it sticks.

en: Anything that is difficult to understand or make sense of.

examples.en: The puzzle has fifty pieces.
The question is a real puzzle.
Where he went after he left the house is a puzzle.
to be in a puzzle
We puzzled over the curious-shaped lock, but were unable to discover how the key should be inserted.

usage: Where he went after he left the house is a puzzle.

en: Level of excellence.

examples.en: This bag is of good quality.
We care about the quality of food.
Quality of life is usually determined by health, education, and income.
One of the qualities of pure iron is that it does not rust easily.
A peasant is not allowed to fall in love with a lady of quality.
To identify quality try asking, "what does it feel like?".

usage: Quality of life is usually determined by health, education, and income.

en: A fundamental, generic term used when referring to the measurement (count, amount) of a scalar, vector, number of items or to some other way of denominating the value of a collection or group of items.

examples.en: We need a large quantity of water.
Buy food in small quantities.
You have to choose between quantity and quality.
Olive oil can be used practically in any quantity.
Generally it should not be used in a quantity larger than 15 percent.
The Boeing P-26A was the first all-metal monoplane fighter produced in quantity for the U.S. Army Air Corps.

usage: You have to choose between quantity and quality.

en: A verbal dispute or heated argument.

examples.en: The brothers had a quarrel.
Do not quarrel with your friend.

to quarrel with one's lot

usage: We got into a silly quarrel about what food to order.

en: A fourth part of something.

examples.en: A quarter of the students left.
examples.cn: 四分之一的学生离开了。

examples.en: It is a quarter past three.
Quarter the horses in the third stable.
a quarter hour; a quarter century; a quarter note; a quarter pound
A quarter day is one terminating a quarter of the year.

usage: Quarter the horses in the third stable.

en: A female monarch. Example: Queen Victoria.

examples.en: The queen ruled the country.
She dressed like a queen.

en: A sentence, phrase or word which asks for information, reply or response; an interrogative.

examples.en: May I ask a question?
The teacher asked a hard question.
What is your question?
The question of seniority will be discussed at the meeting.
He obeyed without question.
I move that the question be put to a vote.

usage: What is your question?

en: Raw or sensitive flesh, especially that underneath finger and toe nails.

examples.cn: 快点，不然我们要迟到了！

He's a quick runner.
That was a quick meal.
You have to be very quick to be able to compete in ad-lib theatrics.
My father is old but he still has a quick wit.

usage: He's a quick runner.

en: The absence of sound; quietness.

examples.en: Please keep quiet in the library.

There was a strange quiet in the normally very lively plaza.
When you quiet, we can start talking.
Can you quiet your child? He's making lots of noise.
I can't hear the music; it is too quiet.

en: (heading) To the greatest extent or degree; completely, entirely.

examples.en: The film was quite good.
She is quite tall for her age.

en: A contest between people, animals, vehicles, etc. where the goal is to be the first to reach some objective. Example: Several horses run in a horse race, and the first one to reach the finishing post wins

examples.cn: 他赢了学校的跑步比赛。

examples.en: We had a race in the park.
The race around the park was won by Johnny, who ran faster than the others.
the race to cure cancer
The drivers were racing around the track.
I raced him to the car, but he was there first, so he got to ride shotgun.

usage: The race around the park was won by Johnny, who ran faster than the others.

en: A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.

examples.en: The railway goes to the city.
We traveled by railway.

en: Pouring with rain; wet; showery

examples.en: It is a rainy day.
We stayed home on the rainy day.
Due to the rainy weather, we decided not to play in the park.

usage: Due to the rainy weather, we decided not to play in the park.

en: An increase in wages or salary; a rise (UK).

examples.en: Please raise your hand.
They raise cows on the farm.
The boss gave me a raise.

We need to raise the motivation level in the company.
Despite all the call congestion, she was eventually able to raise the police.

usage: The boss gave me a raise.

examples.en: There is rapid growth in the city.

a rapid stream

usage: a rapid stream

en: The worth of something; value.

The car was speeding down here at a hell of a rate.

en: The act of stretching or extending; extension.

He reached the book on the shelf.

to reach one a book

en: Ready money; cash

a ready apprehension

He is a real friend.

en: To make real; to convert from the imaginary or fictitious into reality; to bring into real existence

examples.cn: 我现在意识到自己的错误了。

examples.en: She soon realized she was late.
examples.cn: 她很快意识到自己迟到了。

examples.en: The objectives of the project were never fully realized.
He realized that he had left his umbrella on the train.
to realize large profits from a speculation
By realizing the company's assets, the liquidator was able to return most of the shareholders' investments.

usage: realize a dream 实现梦想；名词 realization。

en: In a way or manner that is real, not unreal.

examples.en: I am really tired.
Do you really mean it?
"He really is a true friend." / "Really? What makes you so sure?"
But ma, I really, really want to go to the show!
A: He won the Nobel Prize yesterday.
A: I've just been reading Shakespeare - he's one of the best authors like, ever!

usage: "He really is a true friend." / "Really? What makes you so sure?"

en: A cause:

examples.en: Tell me the reason for this.
For some reason, he left early.
examples.cn: 出于某种原因，他早早离开了。

examples.en: Mankind should develop reason above all other virtues.
I reasoned the matter with my friend.
to reason one into a belief; to reason one out of his plan
to reason down a passion

usage: Mankind should develop reason above all other virtues.

en: An operation in which data is received.

examples.en: I received a letter from her.
He received a gift on his birthday.
She received many presents for her birthday.
to receive a lodger, visitor, ambassador, messenger, etc.
I received a bloody nose from the collision.

usage: 反义词 send（寄）；名词 receipt（收据）。

en: Having happened a short while ago.

examples.en: In recent years, life changed.
The recent news is good.
I met three recent graduates at the conference.

usage: I met three recent graduates at the conference.

en: In the recent past

examples.en: I recently moved to this city.
examples.cn: 我最近搬到了这座城市。

examples.en: She recently learned to swim.
a recently published book

usage: a recently published book

en: To repeat aloud (some passage, poem or other text previously memorized, or in front of one's eyes), often before an audience.

examples.en: Please recite the poem.
He can recite the text.

en: 认出；认可

examples.en: I recognize your voice.
She did not recognize her old friend.
I recognised his face immediately.
The US and a number of EU countries are expected to recognize Kosovo on Monday.
I recognize that my behaviour has been unacceptable.
His services were recognized in a testimonial.

usage: I recognised his face immediately.

en: 推荐

examples.en: I recommend this book to you.
The doctor recommended rest.
The board recommends Philips, given his ample experience in similar positions.
A city that has much to recommend it.
The therapist recommends resting the mind and exercising the body.
A medieval oblate's parents recommended the boy for life to God and the monastery

usage: The board recommends Philips, given his ample experience in similar positions.

en: A disk, usually made of a polymer, used to record sound for playback on a phonograph.

examples.en: Please record the song.
He broke the world record.
The person had a record of the interview so she could review her notes.
We have no record of you making this payment to us.
The heat and humidity were both new records.

usage: The person had a record of the interview so she could review her notes.

en: Recovery.

examples.en: He is slowly recovering.
She recovered from the illness.
After days of inquiries, he finally recovered his lost wallet.
They recovered three of the explorers very much alive, then another, wracked with severe hypothermia, who was taken to hospital.
At the top of the hill I asked to stop for a few minutes to recover my strength.
The plaintiff recovered in his suit, being awarded declaratory relief and a clearing of his name.

usage: After days of inquiries, he finally recovered his lost wallet.

en: An act of recycling.

examples.en: We recycle paper and glass.
Recycle your old bottles.
Both paper and plastic can be recycled.
Sulfur recycles in the sulfur cycle.

usage: Both paper and plastic can be recycled.
